newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Malaysia raises term Tapis price for October.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia raises term Tapis price for October.

text.p: Malaysian state oil company Petronas has increased its October lifting Tapis crude oil term price to $25.70 per barrel compared with $23.01 in September, traders said on Wednesday.
For November, Petronas has set a premium of 75 cents per barrel for term crude oil sales, up from 55 cents in October.
Current fixed differentials against Tapis for other Malaysian grades Labuan and Miri are unchanged, with Labuan 10 cents above Tapis, Miri 10 cents below Tapis and Bintulu 30 cents below Tapis.
The price of October Dulang crude was set at $24.69 per barrel, compared with $22.11 in September.
OCT SEPT AUGUST JULY JUNE MAY APRIL
